Terms of Use

Get Photography & Videography Quotes

These terms govern your use of the Reel The Moment website. They are provided as a general template and should be reviewed before the site goes live.

Using this site

Reel The Moment helps you discover and enquire with event photographers and videographers. We are a discovery and enquiry service, and any agreement for services is made directly between you and the provider you choose.

Enquiries

Information you submit is used to match you with suitable providers. Quotes and availability are provided by those providers.

Content

Imagery on this site is illustrative and is used to show the kinds of events and styles you can explore. It does not represent specific past client work.
